entities.summary: Nick Kellogg is an American professional basketball player who plays for Paris Basketball. He is the son of former National Basketball Association (NBA) player Clark Kellogg. He went to St. Francis DeSales High School in Columbus, Ohio, where he played basketball and competed in consecutive state Final Fours. He played collegiate basketball for Ohio University.
